newsitem.title: UK: Lateral thinkers sought for N Irish peace mission.
newsitem.headline: Lateral thinkers sought for N Irish peace mission.

text.p: A solution to the Northern Irish problem has eluded Britain for a quarter century and foxed the best political brains from Dublin to Washington.

But lateral thinker Edward de Bono reckons his sideways approach to life, coupled with some help from like-minded problem solvers on the Internet, could finally help bring a lasting peace to the province.
De Bono says he wants to involve net surfers to a "design conference" on Northern Ireland, to be launched on Sunday, in a drive to encourage "new thinking".
Political representatives will be invited to monitor the project but de Bono appears the ultimate gate-keeper.
Under his plan, anyone can submit ideas into an "outer ring" at the official de Bono web site.

Should de Bono consider a response constructive or creative, he will invite its writer into the "middle ring" -- a private chat room on the net. The chosen few will have a secret password so only they gain access.
Ultimately, like a sinner travelling through Dante's Inferno, top thinkers will be ushered into de Bono's coveted "inner ring", which will also be open to representatives of political parties.

"The purpose of a design conference is to open up possibilities, new ideas, new ways forward and new designs," said de Bono in a statement. "The purpose of this new thinking is to enrich the field of possibilities so that negotiations have a better chance of success."
His web site is at: http://www.edwdebono.com
